label: A failing test suite has no defined stopping point: implement step 7 lists Validate tests pass as an activity with no on_fail, its pre_completion_validation classifies tooling outcomes rather than test verdicts, and tests_pass appears only in the unowned post gate.

Ranked set: sixteen distinct defects ordered damage-today, led by seven auto-mode confidence STOPs with no mode_overrides.auto default, then the unowned quality_gates block with 26 undefined check ids, then the absent test-failure action.

The ranking inverts the dispatch leads: the plan_clarity arithmetic is latent under a dead block and ranks second-tier, while the auto-mode STOPs, which no lead named, rank first because they stop an unattended run at a self-assigned score.

Seven of the sixteen fixes are one line and four of those are deletions, because the file real enforcement is step prose (on_fail, HARD_BLOCK, action_if_failed) and the declarative blocks that look like enforcement have no consumer.
